items.title: Black Basta Ransomware Leader Added to EU Most Wanted and INTERPOL Red Notice
items.description: Ukrainian and German law enforcement authorities have identified two Ukrainians suspected of working for the Russia-linked ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) group Black Basta. In addition, the group's alleged leader, a 35-year-old Russian national named Oleg Evgenievich Nefedov (Нефедов Олег Евгеньевич), has been added to the European Union's Most Wanted and INTERPOL's Red Notice lists, authorities

items.title: Let’s Encrypt has made 6-day IP-based TLS certificates Generally Available
items.description: Let’s Encrypt, a key provider of free TLS certificates, has rolled out short-lived and IP address-based certificates for general use. These new options became available starting in early 2026, addressing long-standing issues in certificate security.
